notes.title: The Launch of Agent Team Simulator
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, fellow gamers and adventurers![/h2]
I am NerdyBird Luke, the sole member of NerdyBird Studios, and I am thrilled to welcome you all to this exciting new community. With great joy, I was able to release my latest creation, 'Agent Team Simulator', last week, and I extend my deepest gratitude for the incredible support you have shown thus far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478603/2cd0afc2e5bba5214bda71f75ce5fa43f878d936.png[/img]

[h2]The Future is Bright[/h2]
It has been an incredible journey already, and I can see huge potential for this game going forward.
I am happy to share that I already have big plans for the future of 'Agent Team Simulator', and I can't wait to bring you more content and gameplay experiences.
[b]Here's a sneak peek of what's in store:[/b]
[list]
[*][h3][b][u]New Agents[/u][/b][/h3]
I've been actively working on expanding the roster of Agents. Prepare to meet new dynamic characters, some original, some that you may have seen outside of ATS... Also, they'll be brand new ways to unlock some of the fresh faces as well. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478603/a33fbb969e88e66ff73571182dae467018e76679.png[/img]

[*][h3][b][u]New Campaigns[/u][/b][/h3]
You can't have new Agents without new Missions to send them on. I have plans for several new Campaigns, each will feature captivating locations and many twists and turns for you and your Agents. How thrilling!

[*][h3][b][u]Gameplay Development[/u][/b][/h3]
There are a variety of mechanics that I've been considering implementing into ATS to make the game more varied and engaging. I won't make any concrete announcements just yet of what they might be, but rest assured that with some new features, I believe this game can be evolved to the next level.

[*][h3][b][u]Community Involvement[/u][/b][/h3]
At the heart of this game, is you lovely people. And I want your views to be reflected in the game by having features like Community Polls to allow you to have your say on what you would most like to see next in the world of ATS.

[*][h3][b][u]Voice Acting[/u][/b][/h3]
The game may feel little bit bare in the audio department right now to some, but I intend to add some Voice Acting to bring the game to life! To do this, I am pleased to say that will be running an open Casting Call in the near future. Anyone will be able to audition so maybe YOU could become a part of the game!

[*][h3][b][u]Chinese Translation[/u][/b][/h3]
I'm thrilled to announce that the game will be getting a text translation into Chinese, both Simplified and Traditional, which will open up a much larger audience and market for the game, allowing it to reach even more players. This would also pave the way for other potential languages to added in time as well.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478603/4ca6a3f7eefbf6e666602bb71a9eac107d0ded0f.png[/img]

[h2]Your Feedback Matters[/h2]
I want to emphasise that your feedback and input are incredibly valuable to me. I appreciate your passion for 'Agent Team Simulator' and I'm actively listening to your ideas, suggestions, and concerns. Your input helps shape the game and ensures that I can create the best possible experience in ATS.

But if you could please always bear in mind, I am just one man, I will sometimes have limitations to what I can do, and how fast I can do it, if you can remember this when critiquing the game, it would be appreciated. Thank you!

As well as this, I do intend to create and work on other projects as well, as I am trying to build a successful career as an Indie Dev. If you'd like to support my work, you can always purchase the numerous Agent Team Simulator DLCs or even the other Games I have released. I also have a [url=https://www.patreon.com/NerdyBirdStudios][b]Patreon[/b][/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43478603/49831291103344feceebec30203149ea1bf6a56c.png[/img]

[h2]Enjoy the Game[/h2]
A special thanks to ElectricStar for providing a fantastic performance in the Game's Trailer. Please check it out if you haven't already!

Also feel free to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/5GYebNEsb5][b]Discord[/b][/url].

And that's everything folks, thanks so much for your time and for your incredible support and enthusiasm for 'Agent Team Simulator'.

Hope you have fun as you continue to play. Keep watching out for upcoming announcements.

Farewell for now, and see you on the mission field!
NerdyBird Luke.
